notes: Rebuilt 2026-09-21 — this job's invoices are periodically cleaned up (the prior static fixture invoices, #14080 then #17630, both went stale that way, most recently confirmed live via MCP browser). Instead of hand-maintaining a static invoiceId here, TC22_Retainage.spec.js now provisions its own invoice at run time in a top-level beforeAll (RetainagePage.createDraftInvoice() + setRetainagePercent(10) + setLineInvoiceAmount(row, 10) + confirmInvoice()) and shares that one resolvedInvoiceId across every test in the file — no per-test invoice creation, no stale ID to update. The $10 gross / 10% override math below (lineItem/expected) is still the exact target shape (Withheld $1, Net Payable $9, whole-dollar-clean, no rounding ambiguity — see the original reasoning this replaces: smaller overrides like 4% produce sub-$1 withheld amounts the Overview panel rounds down to $0 on display) — the beforeAll recreates precisely this, so these values still describe the invoice under test, they just aren't looked up by a hardcoded invoiceId anymore.
